caption: The drawing depicts a wooden mantel clock with an arched top and rectangular base. The clock is primarily brown, representing wood, with black columns on each side of the central section. At the top of the clock is a round clock face with Roman numerals and two black hands indicating the time. The clock face background is light beige or cream. Below the clock face, there is a circular panel bordered by blue rings, and inside this panel is a colored illustration of two birds. One bird is red and blue, while the other is mainly pink; they are perched on green pine branches adjacent to a brown pine cone. There are triangular gold accents in the four corners between the two main circles. A gold or brass winding key protrudes from the left side of the clock. The entire composition is centered on a plain, light tan background.
title: Mantel Clock
